projection_policy.comparison: initial C1_COUPLED−OFF T0 mixing-ratio difference versus proposal−OFF POST-state contrast at T1
projection_policy.interpretation: descriptive alignment only; not causal attribution
projection_policy.undefined_cases: projection is null for exact-zero baseline norm; cosine is null if either vector norm is zero

scope: one native KDM6 call at model time 20 s (T1): captured PRE and POST states and their increment; not full host history or end-of-forecast state
units: Q* mixing ratios kg/kg dry; signed_sum is a cell sum, not extensive water mass
